people.name: Ezra
people.line: Priest; scribe; led a group of exiles back to Jerusalem.

people.name: Jehozadak
people.line: Father of Joshua the high priest during the exile.

people.name: Joiakim
people.line: A high priest, son of Jeshua

people.name: Joshua
people.line: High priest during the rebuilding of the temple

people.name: Nehemiah
people.line: Governor of Judah, rebuilt Jerusalem's walls.

translations.web: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest and scribe.
translations.bsb: They served in the days of Joiakim son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor and Ezra the priest and scribe.
translations.kjv: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.
translations.asv: These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor, and of Ezra the priest the scribe.
